layouts.name: Larkhall Kart Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Pre-extension course follows the full northern bend, central return and southern hairpin using the pinned January 2018 raceways. Motorsport UK documents the later extension from 852 to 1140 m. The independently mapped historic route measures 850.4 m; current extension branches are excluded. Historical alignment and direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 850.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
